content.title: About
content.content: Scalloped potato with fresh meat is a classic baked dish where thin slices of fresh potatoes are layered with tender pieces of meat and baked in a creamy sauce. The result is a comforting, buttery flavor with juicy meat and soft potatoes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The dish is traditionally assembled in layers, alternating potatoes and meat.
Common meats are beef or pork, but chicken or turkey can also be used.
The creamy sauce is usually made from milk, cream, and flour, giving the dish its smooth texture.
Baking allows the potatoes to fully absorb the flavors of the meat and sauce.
Some regional variations add cheese on top for a golden crust.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Potatoes provide slowly digestible carbs that supply steady energy.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: The meat component delivers complete protein essential for tissue repair and growth.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Both potatoes and meat contain B6 and B12 vitamins, supporting nervous system function and metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: The dish supplies potassium, iron, and zinc, which help maintain electrolyte balance and immune health.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Potato skins and any added vegetables contribute fiber that aids digestion.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: The creamy sauce and meat make the dish calorie‑dense; portion control is advisable.

items.title: Saturated fat
items.content: Cream and meat can increase saturated fat intake, which may be a concern for heart health.

items.title: Dairy allergy or lactose intolerance
items.content: Those with dairy sensitivities should substitute cream with plant‑based alternatives.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Added salt in the sauce can be problematic for individuals with hypertension.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dish hot as a main course, often accompanied by a green salad or vegetable side. Garnish with fresh herbs for extra aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat in the oven to retain the crispy top.
